name: styles
facts: The catalog holds 32 styles, indexed alphabetically in reference/styles.md with one spec file each under reference/styles/
Every cell is that style's own full-width specimen from docs/samples/, scaled down — not a redrawing of it
The sheet is gated as the declared 'catalog-sheet' style, so each tile's filters are measured against the floor of the style they depict
scripts/styles.json is the checker's machine-readable half of the same catalog
